question: Which GSE242510 barcodes support conservative fibroblast-like or macrophage-like annotation under two fixed technical QC masks, without using Arg1 or Il6?
decision: Qualify library-by-class coverage and held-out marker compatibility before subsequent descriptive Arg1/Il6 endpoints; retain unresolved classes and technical exclusions.
strongest_rival: Ambient RNA, mixed cells, broad markers, culture activation and QC-based selection may mimic a clean cell identity; compatible markers are not validated lineage or doublet exclusion.
discriminator: Use prespecified multi-marker and alternative-lineage rules, keep mixed/unassigned cells, display independent-of-label held-out marker compatibility and both QC masks, then apply a fixed coverage floor.
exposure_record: Published outcomes, functional reconstructions and full-library technical QC are exposed. No local cell-class Arg1/Il6 result has been calculated. Marker rules and endpoint-independent coverage criteria freeze before endpoint extraction.
biological_unit: Animals for whole-lung panels; human donor pairs or patients for human assays; coculture preparation identity and pooling remain unknown for GSE242510.
nesting_and_overlap: Slices and wells nest in source patients or donor combinations; cells nest in libraries. Numeric library suffixes do not prove preparation pairing. Source panels and deposited data are reused published evidence, not independent replication.
population_and_selection: The official JCI188734 supporting-values workbook and six GSE242510 libraries, with linked public BioSample and sequencing records. Source-selected published panels; no new cohort.
contrast: Six separate libraries and two prespecified QC masks; no genotype expression effect is estimated in this annotation run.
endpoint: Conservative raw-count marker-compatible labels, retained and excluded class counts, marker detection fractions, held-out compatibility and library/class eligibility.
methods: Use the exact annotation_spec_v1.json multi-marker count rules and two QC masks. Join the frozen cell-QC table by GSM and barcode; verify total-count consistency. At least 20 cells and at least 50% with one held-out marker at >=2 counts qualify a library/class for descriptive endpoint work.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep every barcode in outputs; preserve mixed, other-or-mixed, unassigned and QC-excluded states. Missing or duplicate required marker symbols stops the run. No endpoint-driven retuning or condition-label override.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests, differential expression or primary-endpoint selection.
precision_basis: Technical source checks do not estimate population precision.
interpretation_limit: Marker-compatible core classes only, not exact SingleR/DoubletFinder reproduction, validated lineage, pure populations or independent preparations. Coverage threshold is not a power calculation.
stop_rule: Stop after endpoint-free annotation and technical class support. Only qualifying library/classes proceed under a separate frozen endpoint contract; retain every failed class or source dependency.
amendment_reason: Initial endpoint-free conservative annotation adaptation after full-entry integrity qualification.
